title: Student Success Labs
description: The goal of Student Success Labs is to help you achieve your goals and overcome obstacles such as stress, planning, anxiety, and motivation. Success Labs boast talks by faculty, administrators, and experts who lead hands-on workshops. The sessions are open to anyone looking to achieve a goal, particularly academic and/or personal. Must be taken with other credit bearing courses or courses that equate to full-time.

title: FIP Seminar
description: This class is intended to help you reflect on your fall experience and learn more about yourself in terms of how you learn and what motivates you. You’ll be provided strategies to guide the reflections and participate in activities that will engage you with the ins and outs of learning at RPI. Must be taken with other credit bearing courses or courses that equate to full-time.

title: Undergraduate Final Administrative Registration
description: This is an administrative registration course for undergraduate students who have no other courswork to take to meet their degree requirements or are waiting for transfer credits to be received to meet degree requirements. Also used if finishing up an I grade from the previous term and that is all that is needed for completion of requirements. Students must apply and graduate in the term this course is processed on their record.

title: Graduate Field Work
description: Allows full-time student status for graduate students continuing their research by conducting approved field work that is equal to full time study/contact hours.

title: Family and Childbirth Accommodation
description: Allows full-time student status to continue for a specific timeframe that may be during and/or after childbirth/adoption, and to facilitate the return to full participation in class work and, where applicable, research, teaching and clinical training in a seamless manner.

title: Graduate Final Administrative Registration
description: This is an administrative registration course for gradiate students who have no other courswork / research/thesis credits to take to meet their degree requirements, have defended their thesis within the term add deadline, or are finishing up ‘I’ grade requirements only from a previous term. Students must apply and graduate in the term this course is processed on their record. Less than half-time student status.

title: Summer Administrative Registration
description: Allows full-time student status for graduate students continuing their research on campus, or working as TA/RA on campus, during the summer term, that is equal to full time study/contact hours. Student must have been registered in the prior Spring term and should be registered for the subsequent Fall term.

title: Orientation Seminar for Graduate Students
description: All new graduate students, including co-terminal, are required to complete the academic orientation seminar course. Must be taken with other credit bearing courses or courses that equate to full-time.

title: Graduate Teaching Assistant Training
description: All new PhD students are required to participate in the TA Training Program, which emphasizes understanding the details and the importance of the role as a teaching assistant. All other graduates awarded a new teaching assistantship must attend the TA Training, regardless of prior teaching experience or previous attendance at Rensselaer. Must be taken with other credit bearing courses or courses that equate to full-time.
